steps.title: Open My place
steps.body: Choose Personal, a salon you manage, or your staff workplace.

steps.title: Check your access
steps.body: Check the salon name. Available tools depend on your role and permissions.

account.title: Account & sign-in
account.summary: Sign up, sign in or recover access.

steps.title: Create or open your account
steps.body: Use Sign up for a new account, or sign in with your existing account.

steps.title: Check My place
steps.body: Open the right workspace. Use Forgot password if you cannot sign in.

open-or-claim.title: Add or claim a salon
open-or-claim.summary: Find your salon before adding one.

steps.title: Search first
steps.body: Look for the salon by name and address to avoid duplicates.

steps.title: Create or request access
steps.body: Add a new salon, or follow the claim steps for an existing listing. Wait for the result.

find-and-book.title: Find & book a salon
find-and-book.summary: Choose a salon, service and time.

steps.title: Find a salon
steps.body: Open Explore and choose a salon. Open its booking page.

steps.title: Choose and confirm
steps.body: Select services, staff and an available time. Review the details, submit and check the booking status.

steps.title: Prepare services and staff
steps.body: Activate services, assign booking staff and set their working hours.

steps.title: Review booking settings
steps.body: Open booking settings, check availability and share the public booking link.

owner-tips.title: Daily salon checklist
owner-tips.summary: Open, serve customers and close the day.

steps.title: Before opening
steps.body: Check the salon, services, staff, bookings and POS sync status.

steps.title: Before leaving
steps.body: Review closed tickets and actual collections. Reconcile the business day.

windows-portable.title: Windows POS
windows-portable.summary: Daily use, syncing and staff turns.

steps.title: Open the correct salon
steps.body: Sign in with your POS ID and check the salon and sync status.

steps.title: Keep work in sync
steps.body: Save your work and check pending items before closing the app. Use the tasks below for staff turns.

pos-and-displays.title: POS & customer display
pos-and-displays.summary: Install POS and pair a second screen.

steps.title: Open POS settings
steps.body: Choose the Windows app or the available browser option. Check staff access.

steps.title: Pair the display
steps.body: Follow the customer display setup. Open the pairing link on the intended device and check its salon.

steps.title: Check the person and ticket
steps.body: Staff check-in records attendance. On a customer ticket, check services, staff, prices and tips.

steps.title: Record payment once
steps.body: Collect payment, record the actual amount and method, then complete Checkout. Check the result before retrying.

staff-connections.title: Connect to your workplace
staff-connections.summary: Accept an invite or apply to a salon.

steps.title: Open Connections
steps.body: Check the salon and staff profile before accepting an invitation or sending an application.

steps.title: Open your staff workplace
steps.body: After approval, open the salon in My place and check your schedule and pay access.

payroll-and-tax.title: Payroll & tax records
payroll-and-tax.summary: Live income, change history and payment evidence.

steps.title: Review the live calculation
steps.body: Choose the salon, period and staff. Review services, tips, hours and effective pay rules, including past periods.

steps.title: Compare payment evidence
steps.body: Open Change history and Recorded payments. Recalculation can change the amount due; it does not rewrite an actual payment or transfer money.

steps.title: Choose the salon and date
steps.body: Open Reports and check the business day and timezone.

steps.title: Compare actual collections
steps.body: Compare cash, card totals, tips and expenses. Review differences before saving the day report.

profiles-and-posts.title: Profiles & posts
profiles-and-posts.summary: Edit your profile and share your work.

steps.title: Choose the right profile
steps.body: Open Beauty for your personal profile, or Salon Profile for the selected salon.

steps.title: Review before sharing
steps.body: Add your content, check visibility and publish. Open the shared link to check its destination.

troubleshooting.title: Fix a problem & get help
troubleshooting.summary: Check the result before trying again.

steps.title: Check the basics
steps.body: Check the account, salon, date, permissions and connection. Look for the saved result.

steps.title: Send a clear request
steps.body: Open Support. Include the page, time, error and expected result. Hide private information in screenshots.

guides.title: Manage appointments
guides.summary: View, change or cancel a booking.
guides.prerequisite: Use the account linked to your booking. Salon and staff views require the right workplace.

steps.title: Your appointments
steps.body: Open My bookings. Choose Upcoming, Past or Cancelled.

steps.title: Salon and staff views
steps.body: Owners open Bookings for the selected salon. Check the date and the customer before editing.

sections.title: Your appointments
steps: Open My bookings. Choose Upcoming, Past or Cancelled.
Open the appointment details. Use the change or cancellation action when it is available, then check the updated status.
sections.check: The appointment shows the expected time and status.
sections.example: A pending request is not a confirmed appointment.
issues: If no change action is offered, contact the salon. Check the existing appointment before creating another.

sections.title: Salon and staff views
steps: Owners open Bookings for the selected salon. Check the date and the customer before editing.
Staff open Schedule to review assigned appointments and customer notes. Available actions depend on access.
sections.check: You are reviewing the intended salon and appointment.
sections.example: Use the staff schedule for your own assigned work.
issues: If an appointment is missing, check the date, salon and staff assignment.

guides.title: Personal QR & salon check-in
guides.summary: Show your ID or scan the salon QR.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in and connect to the internet to refresh your QR.

steps.title: Check in at a salon
steps.body: Open QR. Show Personal ID to the salon, or choose Scan salon QR.

steps.title: Follow your visit
steps.body: Open the current check-in to see requested services and available staff updates.

sections.title: Check in at a salon
steps: Open QR. Show Personal ID to the salon, or choose Scan salon QR.
Check the salon and select your requested services. Follow the on-screen confirmation and open Your check-ins.
sections.check: Your visit appears under the correct salon.
sections.example: The visit QR lets staff find your current visit.
issues: If the camera cannot open, use Have a check-in link? and paste the salon link. Reconnect if the QR has expired.

sections.title: Follow your visit
steps: Open the current check-in to see requested services and available staff updates.
After payment, use View receipt when it appears.
sections.check: The visit status and saved receipt match your visit.
sections.example: Prices appear after staff save them.
issues: A personal check-in does not record staff attendance.

guides.title: Visits & receipts
guides.summary: Find past visits and saved receipts.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in with the account connected to your visit.

steps.title: Find a receipt
steps.body: Open Activity and select the visit you want to review.

sections.title: Find a receipt
steps: Open Activity and select the visit you want to review.
Open its receipt when available. Review services, discounts, tips, tax and payments.
sections.check: The receipt belongs to the intended salon and date.
sections.example: A completed visit can have a saved receipt linked to its ticket.
issues: If a visit is missing, ask the salon to check the customer connection. Avoid creating a second account.

guides.title: Salon details & opening hours
guides.summary: Address, hours and public visibility.
guides.prerequisite: Select the salon you manage. Editing requires salon settings permission.

steps.title: Update details and hours
steps.body: Open Salon settings. Check the name, address, map location and timezone.

steps.title: Show your salon on Explore
steps.body: Review the publishing checklist for missing location details, description or active services.

sections.title: Update details and hours
steps: Open Salon settings. Check the name, address, map location and timezone.
Set weekly hours and special dates. Save settings and review the public status.
sections.check: The saved hours use the salon timezone.
sections.example: A holiday closure overrides the weekly schedule for that date.
issues: Opening hours and staff booking availability are separate settings.

sections.title: Show your salon on Explore
steps: Review the publishing checklist for missing location details, description or active services.
Complete the required items, save the visibility setting and check your public profile.
sections.check: The public profile shows the intended information.
sections.example: A saved address can still be reviewed when the map is temporarily unavailable.
issues: If publishing is unavailable, review the checklist and your permissions.

guides.title: Services & prices
guides.summary: Keep the menu ready for POS and booking.
guides.prerequisite: Select the salon and use an account with service management permission.

steps.title: Prepare a service
steps.body: Open Services. Add or edit the service name, price, duration and active status.

sections.title: Prepare a service
steps: Open Services. Add or edit the service name, price, duration and active status.
Review eligible staff and booking availability, then save and check the service list.
sections.check: The intended service and price can be selected.
sections.example: A service can require both active staff and working hours before online times appear.
issues: If a service is missing from booking, check its status, staff assignment and hours.

guides.title: Customers & visit records
guides.summary: Find a customer before adding a record.
guides.prerequisite: Select your salon. Editing customer records requires permission.

steps.title: Find or add a customer
steps.body: Search Customers before choosing Create Customer. Check the matching contact details.

sections.title: Find or add a customer
steps: Search Customers before choosing Create Customer. Check the matching contact details.
Open the intended customer to review visits, spending and upcoming appointments. Save only confirmed contact changes.
sections.check: The visit and appointment belong to the correct customer.
sections.example: Similar names can belong to different people.
issues: For Duplicate? matches, review the records carefully before any merge. Ask for help if you cannot confirm the identity.

guides.title: Staff & access
guides.summary: Create profiles, invite accounts and check access.
guides.prerequisite: Use the selected salon with staff management permission.

steps.title: Add or connect staff
steps.body: Open Staff. Find an existing profile before adding a new one.

steps.title: Review booking and pay access
steps.body: Check active status, services and working hours for online booking.

sections.title: Add or connect staff
steps: Open Staff. Find an existing profile before adding a new one.
Search the exact email or phone when inviting an account. Check the profile and salon before sending.
sections.check: The intended account is linked after the invitation is accepted.
sections.example: Creating a staff profile does not automatically connect a personal account.
issues: If more than one account matches, refine the email or phone instead of guessing.

sections.title: Review booking and pay access
steps: Check active status, services and working hours for online booking.
Review payroll setup and allowed actions separately. Keep owner and POS credentials separate.
sections.check: The staff member sees only the tools they are allowed to use.
sections.example: Being available for booking does not grant payroll management access.
issues: If a tool is missing, check the linked profile and permissions before creating another profile.

guides.title: My schedule & workday
guides.summary: Appointments, hours and attendance.
guides.prerequisite: Your account must be linked to an active staff profile in the selected salon.

steps.title: Review your schedule
steps.body: Open Schedule. Select the day or week and open an assigned appointment.

steps.title: Check your workday
steps.body: Open your staff workplace and review the work date and salon.

sections.title: Review your schedule
steps: Open Schedule. Select the day or week and open an assigned appointment.
Check the time, services and customer notes. Use Settings → My working hours & time off for available schedule settings.
sections.check: The schedule is for the intended salon and staff profile.
sections.example: Your online booking hours can differ from your recorded attendance.
issues: Ask the manager if a change requires approval or the controls are unavailable.

sections.title: Check your workday
steps: Open your staff workplace and review the work date and salon.
Use the available Check In or Check Out action and verify the saved time.
sections.check: The saved attendance belongs to the correct workday.
sections.example: A checked-out workday may be read-only.
issues: If the saved time is wrong, ask the manager to review it rather than repeating check-in.

sections.title: Scan a customer visit
steps: Open Scan in your staff workplace. The salon owner must enable it first.
Scan the customer visit QR, then check the customer and requested services. Review amounts and the saved status before leaving the screen.
Stand by closes the editor while keeping current work. Check the result before scanning or submitting again.
sections.check: Your current work shows the intended customer and services.
sections.example: Use the visit QR for the current salon visit.
issues: If POS changed the record, review the latest POS values before continuing. Reconnect before sending offline changes.

guides.title: Saved posts & following
guides.summary: Return to posts, salons and Beauty profiles.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in with the account that saved or followed the content.

steps.title: Find saved posts
steps.body: Open More → Saved Post. Search or filter by the available post types.

steps.title: Manage following
steps.body: Open More → Following. Choose Shops or Beauty to narrow the list.

sections.title: Find saved posts
steps: Open More → Saved Post. Search or filter by the available post types.
Open a saved item to return to the original post. Remove it from saved items when you no longer need it.
sections.check: The item opens the intended original content.
sections.example: Removing a saved item does not delete the original post.
issues: Removed or restricted posts may no longer open.

sections.title: Manage following
steps: Open More → Following. Choose Shops or Beauty to narrow the list.
Open the intended profile, or use the available unfollow action.
sections.check: The list reflects the profiles followed by this account.
sections.example: Following a salon does not create an appointment.
issues: If the list looks wrong, check the signed-in account.

guides.title: Promote salon posts
guides.summary: Audience, credit limits and results.
guides.prerequisite: Use the Owner workspace for your active salon. Campaign availability and credits must be checked in the app.

steps.title: Review before starting
steps.body: Choose the intended salon post. Review the audience area, daily view limit and duration.

steps.title: Review campaign results
steps.body: Open Campaigns and select the campaign to review its status and results.

sections.title: Review before starting
steps: Choose the intended salon post. Review the audience area, daily view limit and duration.
Check the maximum campaign credits and final confirmation. Start only after reviewing the amount.
sections.check: The campaign uses the selected post, area and credit limit.
sections.example: A daily view limit is a maximum; it does not guarantee views or bookings.
issues: If credits are insufficient, review the current balance and purchase terms before paying.

sections.title: Review campaign results
steps: Open Campaigns and select the campaign to review its status and results.
Use the offered cancellation action if needed. Check the updated status and credit balance afterward.
sections.check: The saved campaign status matches the action taken.
sections.example: Example numbers in setup are illustrations, not actual results.
issues: If a credit purchase is still being checked, review its result before starting another purchase.

guides.title: Market & add-ons
guides.summary: Check availability, permissions and plans.
guides.prerequisite: Select the active salon you own before managing add-ons.

steps.title: Review an add-on
steps.body: Open Market and select an add-on. Read its features, permissions and availability.

sections.title: Review an add-on
steps: Open Market and select an add-on. Read its features, permissions and availability.
If activation is offered, review the displayed trial or payment terms and confirm for the correct salon.
sections.check: The add-on status shows whether it is active for that salon.
sections.example: A preview or sample listing is not an installed feature.
issues: Prices and available plans can change. Check the final screen rather than an older guide.

sections.title: Booking SMS reminders
steps: Open BookSMS in Market for the intended salon. Review its current availability, plan and SMS allowance.
When access is active, use the plugin settings to configure the salon sender and choose booking updates and reminders.
sections.check: The plugin shows the intended salon sender and preferences.
sections.example: Enabling app notifications does not activate booking SMS.
issues: Delivery depends on active access, allowance and provider setup. Review delivery status before sending the same message again.

guides.title: Booking deposits
guides.summary: Set payment rules and check receipts.
guides.prerequisite: The salon needs active access to Booking Deposit and the required Stripe connection.

steps.title: Set the booking payment rule
steps.body: Open Booking Deposit for the intended salon and complete the offered connection steps.

steps.title: Check a booking payment
steps.body: Review the appointment payment status and the available Stripe receipt.

sections.title: Set the booking payment rule
steps: Open Booking Deposit for the intended salon and complete the offered connection steps.
Choose whether payment is required and review the offered fixed, percentage or full-payment options. Save the settings.
sections.check: The saved rule matches the amount customers are asked to pay.
sections.example: Booking payment and the remaining visit balance must be reviewed together.
issues: If access or Stripe setup is incomplete, finish those steps before expecting a payment request.

sections.title: Check a booking payment
steps: Review the appointment payment status and the available Stripe receipt.
Check whether payment completed before asking the customer to pay again. Use the offered support path for an uncertain result.
sections.check: The confirmed payment belongs to the correct appointment.
sections.example: An unfinished checkout is not proof that a booking payment succeeded.
issues: Do not assume cancellation automatically refunds a payment; review its actual payment and refund status.

guides.title: Settings & account security
guides.summary: Profile, devices and account recovery.
guides.prerequisite: Use your own account. Some changes require a security check.

steps.title: Choose the right settings
steps.body: Open Settings. Choose Personal, a salon you manage, or your staff workplace.

steps.title: Review account access
steps.body: Open Login, devices & security. Review sessions, trusted devices and available two-factor options.

sections.title: Choose the right settings
steps: Open Settings. Choose Personal, a salon you manage, or your staff workplace.
Open the needed item, make the change and choose Save. Use Cancel to leave without saving.
sections.check: The saved change belongs to the intended account or salon.
sections.example: Personal contact details and salon contact details are separate.
issues: If an item is missing, check the selected workspace and your permissions.

sections.title: Review account access
steps: Open Login, devices & security. Review sessions, trusted devices and available two-factor options.
Follow the security checks before saving. Keep recovery codes private; use account recovery if you lose access.
sections.check: Only your intended sessions and recovery details remain.
sections.example: A recovery code is private, just like a password.
issues: Never include passwords, verification codes or recovery codes in a support message.

sections.title: Ownership & salon status
steps: In Settings, open the intended salon and review Owners, ownership history & transfer.
Use Salon status, backup & permanent closure to review the salon status and any unfinished records. Read all requirements before confirming a change.
Personal account deletion is a separate option under Personal account. Check its requirements before continuing.
sections.check: You have reviewed the correct salon, owner and unfinished work.
sections.example: Permanent salon closure keeps historical records available; it is different from changing weekly hours.
issues: The last owner cannot leave without another owner. Keep all identity checks and confirmation steps.

guides.title: Notifications
guides.summary: Read updates and find pending actions.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in and check the active account and workplace.

steps.title: Review updates
steps.body: Open Notifications. Use the All or Unread filter and open an item for details.

steps.title: Choose notification preferences
steps.body: Open notification Settings from the page, or Settings → Notifications.

sections.title: Review updates
steps: Open Notifications. Use the All or Unread filter and open an item for details.
Review Needs action separately. Reading an update does not complete the action it asks for.
sections.check: Read status and pending actions match what you have done.
sections.example: Mark all viewed changes read status; it does not approve a request.
issues: Use Retry if loading fails, or Load older notifications for earlier items.

sections.title: Choose notification preferences
steps: Open notification Settings from the page, or Settings → Notifications.
Review the available preferences and save your choices.
sections.check: Your saved preferences are shown when you reopen settings.
sections.example: App preferences and device notification permissions are separate.
issues: If alerts do not appear, check both app preferences and the device settings.

guides.title: My rewards
guides.summary: Points and offers from each salon.
guides.prerequisite: Use the personal account linked to your visits. Each salon has its own rules.

steps.title: Check your points
steps.body: Open My Rewards and choose the salon. Review available points, pending points and offers.

steps.title: Use a reward on a visit
steps.body: Open your current visit from My QR, or review the customer display. Choose an eligible reward.

sections.title: Check your points
steps: Open My Rewards and choose the salon. Review available points, pending points and offers.
Use your linked account or Personal QR when visiting. Check the completed, fully paid visit before expecting eligible points.
sections.check: Your points appear under the salon where they were earned.
sections.example: A booking estimate is pending; it is not available points yet.
issues: If points are missing, review the visit and the salon rules before contacting support.

sections.title: Use a reward on a visit
steps: Open your current visit from My QR, or review the customer display. Choose an eligible reward.
Review points, eligible services and minimum spend. Confirm the choice yourself and check the final receipt.
sections.check: The receipt shows the confirmed reward for that visit.
sections.example: Staff may suggest a reward; the customer confirms its use.
issues: Points from one salon do not become points at another salon.

guides.title: Set up salon rewards
guides.summary: Earning rules, offers and local discovery.
guides.prerequisite: Use the Owner workspace for the active salon.

steps.title: Preview and activate rewards
steps.body: Open Reward System. Review earning rules, point costs, discount values and eligible services.

steps.title: Review activity or pause earning
steps.body: Review Reward activity for the selected day and compare the related visits.

sections.title: Preview and activate rewards
steps: Open Reward System. Review earning rules, point costs, discount values and eligible services.
Read Customer preview and the readiness checklist. Confirm Activate local rewards when ready, then check the saved status.
sections.check: The saved program shows the intended rules and discovery status.
sections.example: Your salon provides the service discounts; reward points belong to that salon.
issues: Spend points use complete thresholds on each fully paid receipt. Remainders do not carry between receipts.

sections.title: Review activity or pause earning
steps: Review Reward activity for the selected day and compare the related visits.
Use Pause, hide discovery or save a draft to adjust new earning or Explore visibility. Save and verify the result.
sections.check: The saved earning and discovery status matches your choice.
sections.example: Pausing new earning preserves existing balances and confirmed rewards.
issues: A readiness error may require updating the public salon profile or location.

guides.title: My gift cards
guides.summary: Receive, share and use a salon gift card.
guides.prerequisite: Check the issuing salon. Keep the card code, PIN and private link secure.

steps.title: Receive or share a card
steps.body: Open the gift card link and check the salon and balance. Use Add to my Reylumi wallet when offered.

steps.title: Use the card at its salon
steps.body: At checkout, follow Gift card → Use on the connected customer flow or ask staff to open it.

sections.title: Receive or share a card
steps: Open the gift card link and check the salon and balance. Use Add to my Reylumi wallet when offered.
To give the card, use Share link, Save image or the email draft option. Use the newest code and PIN.
sections.check: The wallet or latest transfer shows the intended card.
sections.example: Each new transfer replaces the earlier code. Copies of the same current image share one balance.
issues: Anyone with the current code and PIN may spend the card. Do not post them publicly.

sections.title: Use the card at its salon
steps: At checkout, follow Gift card → Use on the connected customer flow or ask staff to open it.
Review the amount applied and any remaining balance. Check the saved receipt before retrying.
sections.check: The card balance and receipt reflect the completed payment.
sections.example: A card is valid at its issuing salon.
issues: Do not use an older transfer code after creating a new one.

guides.title: Sell & manage gift cards
guides.summary: Sales, balances, design and activity.
guides.prerequisite: Select the salon you own. Online sales require the offered payment setup.

steps.title: Prepare and sell a card
steps.body: Open gift card management. Review Settings, sales availability and the card Design.

steps.title: Review cards and activity
steps.body: Use Cards for balances and status. Use History to inspect sales and linked tickets.

sections.title: Prepare and sell a card
steps: Open gift card management. Review Settings, sales availability and the card Design.
For counter sales, open POS → Gift card → Buy. Check the amount, payment and recipient, then verify the saved sale.
sections.check: The sale and delivery match the intended salon and value.
sections.example: Counter sales can use cash or the existing card terminal; online sales check Stripe readiness.
issues: Do not issue a second card while the first payment result is uncertain.

sections.title: Review cards and activity
steps: Use Cards for balances and status. Use History to inspect sales and linked tickets.
Review the displayed activity before exporting or using a lock action. Check the result after any change.
sections.check: The card status and activity explain its current balance.
sections.example: Disabling new sales preserves existing balances for use.
issues: Voiding an unused sale is separate from returning money through the original payment method.

guides.title: Reylumi membership
guides.summary: Compare plans, plugin access and allowances.
guides.prerequisite: Membership is assigned per salon. Read the current plan terms.

steps.title: Review a plan
steps.body: Open Membership and compare monthly or annual plans, included services and support scope.

steps.title: Understand included access
steps.body: An active membership includes released Reylumi plugins. Choose and activate the needed tools in Market with their permissions.

sections.title: Review a plan
steps: Open Membership and compare monthly or annual plans, included services and support scope.
If enrollment is open, use the offered contact action. The membership page does not collect payment.
sections.check: You understand the plan for the intended salon and its current enrollment status.
sections.example: A preview plan or an Enrollment not open label is not an active membership.
issues: Do not treat a membership request as payment confirmation.

sections.title: Understand included access
steps: An active membership includes released Reylumi plugins. Choose and activate the needed tools in Market with their permissions.
Check service allowances, rollover and approved additional usage. Third-party plugins and payment processing are separate.
sections.check: Plugin access and service allowance are understood separately.
sections.example: The Reylumi Member badge identifies membership; it does not verify service quality.
issues: Existing separate subscriptions are not automatically cancelled by requesting a membership.

guides.title: Owner forum
guides.summary: Find discussions, post and follow replies.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in with an account eligible for the Owner forum.

steps.title: Find or start a discussion
steps.body: Search the forum and choose a section or state filter to find a relevant topic.

steps.title: Return to discussions
steps.body: Use Follow this post or save a topic when you want to return to it.

sections.title: Find or start a discussion
steps: Search the forum and choose a section or state filter to find a relevant topic.
Open a topic to reply. For a new discussion, enter a short title, choose the section and review the body before posting.
sections.check: The post appears in the intended section.
sections.example: Draft text is saved for the current browser session; check that the post was actually published.
issues: Avoid private customer, payroll and account details in public discussions.

sections.title: Return to discussions
steps: Use Follow this post or save a topic when you want to return to it.
Open the forum profile menu for Following, saved topics or your own posts. Use Report for content that needs review.
sections.check: The followed or saved discussion is available in the matching list.
sections.example: Following a forum topic is separate from following a salon profile.
issues: A locked discussion or participation restriction can limit posting. Read its message or contact support.

guides.title: Check Writer
guides.summary: Prepare, review and print checks.
guides.prerequisite: Use the Owner workspace with active Check Writer access. Unlock it when required.

steps.title: Review a check before printing
steps.body: Open Check Writer. Choose the available payroll source or New check, then verify the payee and amount.

steps.title: Review print history
steps.body: Open History to check whether a check was already created before starting another one.

sections.title: Review a check before printing
steps: Open Check Writer. Choose the available payroll source or New check, then verify the payee and amount.
Review check settings and the preview. Test alignment on plain paper before using check stock.
sections.check: The preview has the correct payee, amount and alignment.
sections.example: A printed check is not proof that a bank payment has cleared.
issues: Keep the unlock check. Do not put bank details in screenshots or support messages.

sections.title: Review print history
steps: Open History to check whether a check was already created before starting another one.
Use only the available recovery or reprint action after reviewing the existing result.
sections.check: You can identify the intended check without creating a duplicate.
sections.example: An interrupted print can still have a saved check record.
issues: Do not bypass access or create another check solely because printing did not finish.

guides.title: Photo library
guides.summary: Find photos from your Beauty posts.
guides.prerequisite: Sign in with the account that published the photos.

steps.title: Find a photo or its post
steps.body: Open Library. Choose All, Photos or Before & After to filter your photos.

sections.title: Find a photo or its post
steps: Open Library. Choose All, Photos or Before & After to filter your photos.
Browse photos grouped by month. Tap a photo to open its original post.
sections.check: The photo opens the matching Beauty post.
sections.example: Library shows photos from your posts; it is separate from Saved Post.
issues: If the view is empty, try All and check the account. A post needs available photo media to appear.
